triage_rationale: COMPLEX task requiring full architectural intervention across 21+ files. Three critical failure domains: (1) Workspace conflict bug — video/image insertion conflicts with main workspace because canvasRef, lastRenderResultRef, and videoEngineRef are shared across ALL render modes; paintAsciiToCanvas always uses Canvas 2D context regardless of tier selection; video engine and procedural render loop both write to the same canvasRef causing frame corruption; (2) Hardware acceleration tiers are gimmicks — paintAsciiToCanvas always calls canvas.getContext('2d') and fillText, ignoring activeTier state entirely; src/engine/webgpu-renderer.ts and src/engine/webgl-renderer.ts are stubs that always fall back to CPU; src/lib/renderers/webgpu.ts and src/lib/renderers/webgl.ts contain actual GPU implementations but are never imported by App.tsx; RenderEngineManager exists but is never instantiated; (3) Lockscreen/zen fullscreen mode is missing — Header.tsx has no lock button, tauri.conf.json has fullscreen:false, no Tauri fullscreen API integration exists. Changes span React components, engine files, Tauri bridge, CSS, contracts, and type definitions.
framework: Tauri v2 + React 19 + Vite + TypeScript 5.8 + Tailwind CSS 3.4

conflicts_detected.description: Shared canvasRef workspace conflict. When user inserts video/image, videoEngineRef.onFrame callback (line 264: paintAsciiToCanvas(canvasRef.current, text, optionsRef.current, ...)) writes to the same canvasRef that the procedural 3D render loop (lines 422-427) also writes to. Switching tabs does NOT cleanly isolate workspaces. The useEffect at line 338-351 repaints on activeTab change but the video engine may still be running its frame loop. lastRenderResultRef is also shared across modes.

Hardware acceleration tiers are gimmicks. paintAsciiToCanvas (lines 33-123) ALWAYS uses canvas.getContext('2d') and fillText regardless of activeTier. activeTier state is set via globalTierManager.detectCapabilities() but is NEVER used to select between WebGPU/WebGL/Canvas2D implementations. src/lib/renderers/webgpu.ts and src/lib/renderers/webgl.ts contain actual GPU shader implementations but are NEVER imported by App.tsx. src/engine/webgpu-renderer.ts and src/engine/webgl-renderer.ts are stubs that always fall back to renderImageDataToAscii (CPU).

Lockscreen/zen fullscreen mode is missing. Header.tsx has no lock/unlock button. tauri.conf.json has fullscreen: false. No Tauri window.setFullscreen() API integration exists. Need to add a minimal lock/unlock button in the top-right corner of Header that toggles Tauri fullscreen and pauses all rendering engines when locked.

Duplicate renderer classes: src/engine/webgpu-renderer.ts and src/engine/webgl-renderer.ts are stubs that always fall back to renderImageDataToAscii (CPU), while src/lib/renderers/webgpu.ts and src/lib/renderers/webgl.ts contain the actual GPU shader implementations. This naming collision creates confusion and dead code. RenderEngineManager in src/lib/renderers/manager.ts is also never used.

video_image_failure_analysis:
VIDEO WORKSPACE CONFLICT: When user selects a video file, handleSelectVideoFile (line 541-571) calls videoEngineRef.current.loadSource(file) and videoEngineRef.current.play(). The VideoStreamingEngine's onFrame callback (line 264) calls paintAsciiToCanvas(canvasRef.current, text, optionsRef.current, renderResult?.colorBuffer). This writes to the SAME canvasRef that the procedural 3D render loop uses when activeTab === 'procedural_3d'. Switching tabs does NOT stop the video engine's frame loop — it only pauses it (line 301). The video element itself is never rendered in the DOM; VideoStreamingEngine must capture frames internally. When the user then switches back to video, the useEffect at line 338-351 repaints but the video engine may have already rendered frames to canvasRef.

IMAGE WORKSPACE CONFLICT: handleSelectImageFile (line 509-533) calls rasterizeImageData which calls paintAsciiToCanvas(canvasRef.current, ...). This also writes to the shared canvasRef. The useEffect at line 477-481 re-rasterizes when activeTab changes to 'image', but lastImageDataRef is shared.

ROOT CAUSE: All rendering modes share canvasRef, lastRenderResultRef, and the paintAsciiToCanvas function which always uses 2D canvas context. No workspace isolation exists between video, image, procedural_3d, and camera_stream modes.
